newsitem.title: GERMANY: MLP H1 97 pre-tax profit rises 29 percent.
newsitem.headline: MLP H1 97 pre-tax profit rises 29 percent.

text.p: German financial services group Marschollek, Lautenschlager und Partner AG (MLP) said on Thursday that its pre-tax profit in the first half of 1997 was 30.8 million marks, up 29 percent.
Group revenues were 154.2 million marks in the first six months at 214.1 million marks, up 39 percent from 154.2 million marks in the same period last year.
The group said in a compulsory statement that it expected a similarly upbeat performance in the second half of 1997 and said the performance in the year to date exceeded their own forecasts.
